items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Yeah. Sure I know 'em. They're my good friends.'

ctx.x: he asked... He went up to a place where there was jamming, and Booker Coleman was up there playing piano. So he asked Booker, "Do you know some musicians around here named Otto Jones and Leonard Phillips?" Booker said, "Yeah! You're talkin' about Pete and Phil." He said, "Yeah. Sure I know 'em. They're my good friends." Les said, "Can you tell me where I can get in contact with them?" Booker said, "Yeah, I can tell you. Come on, get in a car. I'm going to take you out where Phil's playing." So he brought him…
Across the Fourteenth Street Bridge, in Virginia.
